name: Comment
what_it_does: Creates a pending draft comment anchored at the selection and opens its card (measured: in-frame 'Post comment' button); the comment joins the review thread when posted.
behavior: Direct action: Creates a pending draft comment anchored at the selection and opens its card (measured: in-frame 'Post comment' button); the comment joins the review thread when posted. Applied immediately to the document's comment thread; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look. Appears as a speech bubble with a plus sign, labelled 'Comment'.
